name: Scoops and Secrets
source:
You came to this small town for a fresh start new name, new job, new life scooping ice cream at an old fashioned parlor. Your roommate knows more than she admits, your boss carries secrets of her own, and one night in a back alley you see something you were never meant to see. Strangely enough, the women in this city aren't like the women we're used to.

[From [url=https://f95zone.to/threads/scoops-and-secrets-v1-0-lovewaffles.309559/]F95Zone[/url]]
translation:
为了重新开始，你来到这座小镇——换上新名字、找了份新工作，在一家老派冰淇淋店里挖着冰淇淋开启崭新生活。然而你的室友知道的内情远比她承认的要多，你的老板也怀揣着不为人知的秘密；而某个夜晚在后巷里，你更是撞见了本不该入你眼帘的一幕。说来也怪，这座城市里的女人们，跟我们平日里见惯的女性可不太一样。

[摘自[url=https://f95zone.to/threads/scoops-and-secrets-v1-0-lovewaffles.309559/]F95Zone[/url]]
